title: Is continuous Speech Therapy necessary, or can we take breaks in between?
metaTitle: Speech Therapy Continuity and Breaks | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the importance of continuity in Speech Therapy sessions and when breaks can be beneficial. Discover how breaks in therapy can be tailored to meet your child's needs.
html: Continuity often helps maintain progress, but breaks can be taken as per the child’s needs and comfort. We recommend discussing any planned breaks with your child's therapist.
